#en: Only a dead warship can keep secrets this loud. The KN-7893 drifts where the old grav tests tore space thin, its UC markings scoured by storms and weapons fire, yet its navigation heart still cradling the routes no one will acknowledge were ever flown. Whatever pattern Stormline is following was born in these corridors, plotted on these consoles, and buried under layers of classified silence; without this link, every rumor about storm corridors and vanishing convoys remains conveniently deniable. Back on the frontier outpost, settlers spoke in half-finished sentences, and the liaison's reports were redacted to ribbons, all circling the same unspoken truth that led straight to this forgotten hull.
zh: 只有一艘死掉的军舰才装得住这么震耳欲聋的秘密。"KN-7893"漂在旧日引力试验把空间扯薄的地方，它的联殖标识被风暴与炮火磨蚀，可它的导航心脏仍捧着那些无人愿意承认曾被飞过的航线。"风暴线"所追随的那个模式，正是在这些走廊里诞生、在这些控制台上绘出、并被埋进层层机密沉默之下；没有这一环，所有关于风暴走廊与消失车队的传闻就都能方便地矢口否认。回到边境前哨，定居者们说话只说半句，联络官的汇报被涂黑成布条，全都绕着同一个未曾说出口、却直通这具被遗忘船壳的真相打转。

#en: Out here, just above a nameless world, the stars look clean and honest, but the thing humming in its lonely track is anything but; it is a hidden hand on the grav wheel, nudging ships toward the same quiet graves you have been hearing about in spacer bars. Whoever built it trusted that distance and vacuum would keep curious eyes away, that the Settled Systems would accept another bad approach as simple misfortune, not guided intent. Yet the checksum scars in LIST backlogs, the scorched pads at forgotten farms, and the way smugglers in the dark corners of stations all murmur about rerouted settlers prove someone tried to bury the pattern and failed, because their own victims would not stop talking.
zh: 在这里、在一颗无名世界正上方，群星看上去干净而诚实，可在那孤零零的轨道上嗡鸣的东西绝非如此；它是一只搭在引力舵轮上的隐形之手，把船只推向你在太空劫匪酒吧里早已听闻的那些安静坟墓。建造它的人笃信，距离与真空能挡住好奇的眼睛，笃信定居星系会把又一次糟糕的进近当成纯粹的霉运、而非受引导的意图。然而独立盟积压记录里的校验和伤痕、被遗忘农场里烧焦的停机坪，以及星际站阴暗角落里走私者们对"被改道定居者"的齐声低语，都证明有人试图埋掉这个模式却失败了——因为他们的受害者自己不肯闭嘴。

#en: Out here, alone above a nameless world, there is nothing to drown out the whisper of altered routes and dead fleets drifting just beyond sensor range. This orbit is not random; it sits exactly where a careful navigator would splice a hidden branch into a main shipping lane, then scrub the trace behind them. Whoever parked the HX-5912 Ironstrike here is guarding more than cargo, they are sitting on the seam where open traffic brushes against Vector's private lattice of war ghosts and lost convoys. In quieter ports, no one says her callsign out loud anymore, they just mention odd beacon behavior, a buried dataslate on an empty rock, and ship logs from Neon that never quite match the official charts.
zh: 在这里、孤悬于一颗无名世界之上，没有任何东西能盖过被改动航线的低语，以及就在传感器范围外漂着的死掉舰队。这条轨道并非随机；它恰好位于一个谨慎的领航员会把隐藏支线接进主航运道、再抹掉身后痕迹的地方。把"铁击 HX-5912"停在这里的人守护的不只是货物——他们坐在开阔交通与"向量"那张由战争幽灵与失踪车队构成的私人网格相擦的那道缝上。在更安静的港市里，已经没人把她的呼号念出声了，他们只会提起奇怪的信标行为、空岩石上一块被埋的数据板，以及来自霓虹城、永远对不上官方星图的船舶日志。

#en: This tower is where the numbers live, stripped of faces and excuses. Whatever Rourke seeded out on the frontier started as clean graphs and controlled trials in places like this, before it was poured into soil and set loose. The people guarding these halls now are drifters and ghosts, hired blades who only know the paymaster two names up the chain and repeat rumors in half-sentences when the lights flicker. Somewhere in these sealed records is the link between backwater homesteads that stopped behaving like themselves, a crippled beacon whispering bad telemetry, and a courier's twisted flight paths, each fragment pointing toward a pilot who has been flying just outside the edges of everyone's maps.
zh: 这座塔就是那些数字居住的地方，剥去了面孔与借口。鲁尔克在边境播下的东西，起初只是这种地方里干净的图表与受控试验，之后才被倒进土壤、放了出去。如今守着这些回廊的，是流浪者与幽灵、拿钱办事的刀手——他们只认得链条往上的两个名字，在灯光闪烁时只说得半句话的传闻。在这些密封记录里的某处，藏着那些不再像自己的穷乡农场、一座低语着糟糕遥测的残废信标，以及一名信使扭曲的飞行路径之间的联系；每一块碎片都指向一名一直飞在所有人星图边缘之外的飞行员。

#en: The trail bends into this cavern because smugglers prefer stone and silence when they move things they never intend to declare. Here, beneath the rock and humming generators, a quartermaster tallies favors and dead drops that never make it onto official manifests, keeping his records close in case the people above ever decide he is expendable. Those entries tie war salvage, redirected haulers, and quiet payments to a single pattern of jumps that only one navigator could have built.  \nSo far, the path runs from a forgotten outpost to mismatched dock logs near Neon and a corrupted orbital trace, each step hinting that whole shipping lanes are being rewritten in the gaps everyone claims not to recall.
zh: 线索拐进这座洞窟，是因为走私者在运送那些他们从不打算申报的东西时，偏爱石头与沉默。在这里、在岩石与嗡鸣的发电机之下，一名军需官清点着那些永远进不了官方舱单的人情与死信点，把记录留在身边，以防上面的人哪天决定他可以被牺牲。那些条目把战争打捞物、被改道的货船与压低声音的付款，系到同一个只有一名领航员才建得出来的跃迁模式上。  \n目前为止，这条路从一座被遗忘的前哨，延伸到霓虹城附近对不上的船坞日志与一道损坏的轨道痕迹，每一步都暗示：整条整条的航运道正被改写进所有人都声称记不得的那些空隙里。

#en: Out here, the fields sit directly beneath the worst of the Akila Dust Corridor, where every shipment walks a knife-edge between salvation and a crater. Locals say someone has been riding the storms for them, slipping in unseen on suicide vectors and whispering course changes over dead channels the way priests used to mumble prayers. If he walks away from this ridge, he keeps the sky itself as leverage over every freighter, every settler, every missing manifest no one will ever admit to. People talk about a frozen lab where beacons were bent to twist approach paths, and a dead Navy hauler with hand-entered vectors that all carried the same ghost of a voice, the one every rumor insists belongs to him.
zh: 在这里，农田就坐落于阿基拉沙尘走廊最恶劣的那段正下方，每一次货运都走在救赎与弹坑之间的刀刃上。当地人说，有人替他们驾驭风暴，以自杀式的向量无声潜入，在死掉的频道上低声念出航向改动，像神父从前喃喃祈祷那样。若他从这道山脊走脱，他就把天空本身握成了筹码，用以要挟每一艘货船、每一名定居者、每一份没人愿意承认的失踪舱单。人们谈论着一座冰封实验室——信标在那里被掰弯以扭曲进近路径；以及一艘死掉的海军货船——手工输入的向量全都带着同一个声音的幽灵，所有传闻都坚称那是他的声音。

#en: This forgotten relay bunker is where the grid once listened longest, a place built to catch every whisper that drifted past the patrol lines and hold it in cold storage until someone with clearance remembered to care. Concrete sweats, cables sag, and the old UC seal on the door looks more like a warning than a promise. Whatever passed through restricted airspace over Gravelight would have brushed these sensors first, leaving traces in systems designed to archive, not forgive, anomalies.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a nameless backworld cache to a half-spoken tip in a station dive, all pointing toward altered registries, missing mass, and a rigger who keeps turning up just off the official record.
zh: 这座被遗忘的中继掩体，是这张网格曾经聆听最久的地方，一座用来捕捉每一句飘过巡逻线低语、并把它冷存起来、直到某个有权限的人想起要在意的设施。混凝土渗着水，线缆垂着，门上那枚旧联殖印章看起来更像警告而非承诺。凡是穿过"墓光"上空受限空域的东西，都会先擦过这些传感器，在那些为归档、而非为宽恕异常而设计的系统里留下痕迹。  \n\n目前为止，线索从一座无名穷乡储藏点，延伸到某家星际站廉价酒馆里一句只说了一半的线报，全都指向被改动的登记册、失踪的质量，以及一名总是恰好出现在官方记录之外的装配工。

#en: Out here, the air tastes like rust and recycled coolant, and the only thing moving is the dust drifting in a gravity profile that feels just slightly wrong. Whatever is leaching through the soil and rock at this spot carries the same subtle pull as those misaligned satellites and wayward storms; if anything ties his equations to a real place, it is whatever was bottled from ground like this. The story of that strange drift started as a half-joke in a miner's canteen, but every retelling stretched farther: from failed survey rigs, to a frontier moon's bad weather, to a dead relay's missing warnings, until the rumor walked itself all the way out here and waited for someone stubborn enough to follow it.
zh: 在这里，空气尝起来像铁锈与回收冷却液，唯一在动的东西，是在一种感觉略有不妥的引力轮廓里漂着的尘埃。从这片土壤与岩石中渗出的东西，带着与那些错位卫星和脱轨风暴相同的微妙牵引；若说有什么能把他那套方程系到一个真实的地点，那就是从这样的地面里装瓶带走的东西。那场古怪漂移的故事始于矿工食堂里的半句玩笑，可每一次重述都拉得更远：从失败的勘探设备，到某颗边境卫星的恶劣天气，再到一座死掉中继缺失的警告——直到这个传闻自己一路走到这里，等着某个足够固执的人跟上它。

#en: The rock field is where traffic goes to forget itself, a frozen storm of stone and scrap just far enough off the lanes that no one checks the logs too closely.  \nSomeone anchored a signal here years ago, probably meant as a temporary fix to patch a routing error, and then never pulled it down; that oversight left a permanent kink in local jump math, a quiet bend in space Vector has been folding his patterns through ever since.  \nYour previous finds all echo the same skew, from the corrupted registry in that backwater wreck to the misjump traces on the crippled freighter and the nervous directions whispered by relay clerks who keep seeing the same analyst's signature buried in their route corrections.
zh: 石场，就是交通前去遗忘自己的地方——一场由石头与废铁构成的冻结风暴，离航道足够远，没人会细查日志。  \n多年前有人在这里锚定了一个信号，大概本是为了临时修补一处航线错误，然后再没把它撤下来；那次疏忽在当地跃迁数学里留下了一个永久的扭结，一道安静的太空弯折——"向量"从此一直把他的模式折着穿过它。  \n你先前的发现都回响着同样的偏斜：从那具穷乡残骸里损坏的登记册，到那艘残废货船上错跳的痕迹，再到中继文书们紧张兮兮指出的方向——他们在自己的航线修正里不断看到同一名分析员的签名。

#en: The story has to end here, on a rock no one charts, where the air peels metal and the horizon is nothing but dust and static. It is the only place left where the routes she has bent all intersect, a last, ugly knot in the web she has been weaving between convoys and graveyards. In this forgotten installation she is purging consoles, reprogramming beacons, and priming dead man bursts that will fling her version of events across the lanes if no one stops her. The first teller of this tale vanished with a blood smeared slate at a backwater stop, then the pattern of renamed waypoints in a dead survey shack, then the orbital buoy guarded by Spacers that proved someone had been steering ships toward the guns.
zh: 这个故事必须在这里终结——在一块无人测绘的岩石上，那里的空气会剥蚀金属，地平线上只有尘土与静电。这是她弯折过的所有航线唯一还会交汇的地方，是她一直在车队与坟墓之间编织的那张网里最后一个丑陋的结。在这座被遗忘的设施里，她正在清理控制台、重编信标，并预备"死人开关"式的脉冲——若没人阻止她，那会把她的版本的事件甩遍所有航道。这则故事的第一个讲述者带着一块血迹斑斑的数据板在某个穷乡落脚点失踪，接着是一座死掉勘探棚里被改名的航点模式，再接着是那座由太空劫匪把守的轨道浮标——它证明有人一直在把船只引向枪口。

#en:
The Scarrunner hangs in a lazy tumble, lights dead, hull scarred like it scraped along the edge of bad math and lost.  
Whatever happened to its crew started here, when a freighter that always ran clean routes began shaving jumps too close to a certain debris field, adjusting course the same subtle way each time until the last one cracked it open.  
Buried in its systems will be the first hint of that shift, the moment standard procedures were replaced by someone else's numbers.  
So far all I have are a remote outpost's discarded slate and a handful of corrupted misjump traces; both whisper the same small deviations that no one noticed until wrecks started piling up in the same quiet corner of space.
zh:
疤痕快船懒洋洋地翻滚着，灯光熄灭，船壳上的伤痕像是沿着错误数学的边缘擦过然后输了。  
它船员遭遇的一切正是从这里开始的：一艘一直跑干净航线的货船，开始把跃迁削得离某片碎片场太近，每次都同样微妙地调整航向，直到最后一次把它撬开。  
埋在它系统里的，会是那次转变的最初迹象——标准程序被别人的数字取代的那一刻。  
目前为止，我只有一座偏远前哨被丢弃的数据板，以及几段损坏的错跳痕迹；两者都低语着同样那些没人注意到的小偏差，直到残骸开始在太空里同样安静的角落越堆越多。

#en: Buried in frozen soil and silence, the abandoned UC relay bunker is where the sky itself was supposed to be watched and forgotten. Here, atmospheric traces of ships slipping through restricted airspace were filed, rounded off, and eventually ignored by officers who preferred neat reports over messy truths. The deserter chose this place because the evidence was never meant to be seen twice, only summarized and shelved until the war stories dulled. But the same quiet hands that once pushed anomalies off the record could not stop the rumors; scraps of triage logs in the dust outside Akila, a nervous clerk in Gagarin, and a dispute in New Atlantis all pointed back to ships that died on paper yet kept flying.
zh: 埋在冻土与沉默之中，这座废弃的联殖中继掩体，本就是让天空被监视、然后被遗忘的地方。在这里，溜过受限空域的船只的大气痕迹被归档、被磨圆，最终被那些偏爱整齐报告甚于凌乱真相的军官忽略。那名逃兵选中这里，是因为这些证据本就不该被看第二次，只需被摘要并搁置，直到战争故事变得钝钝无趣。可那些曾把异常推离记录的安静之手，挡不住传闻；阿基拉城外尘土里零散的分诊日志、加加林星上一名紧张的文书，以及新亚特兰蒂斯城里一场争执，全都指回那些在纸面上死亡、却仍在飞行的船只。

#en: Coincidences pile up faster down here than trash in the gutters. Too many captains paid in quiet credits for runs that skirt the same empty patch of sky, too many street medics patching burns that do not match any weapon on the market, and a few data brokers suddenly very interested in old UC telemetry. This is where routes get bent, names get shaved off manifests, and somebody who understands jump physics a little too well can hide their trail inside other people's crimes. So far the path is a dead buoy with scrambled logs, a homestead field scarred like something tried to land sideways, and an orbiting station that heard the same static whisper three separate times before its crew called it malfunction.
zh: 在这下面，巧合堆积的速度比阴沟里的垃圾还快。太多船长收了安静的报酬、去跑那些擦过同一片空荡天空的航次；太多街头医生在缝合与市面上任何武器都对不上的灼伤；还有几个数据掮客突然对旧日的联殖遥测大感兴趣。这里正是航线被掰弯、名字被从舱单上刮掉的地方，也是一个对跃迁物理懂得稍微太多的人，能把自己的痕迹藏进别人罪行里的地方。目前为止，这条路是一枚日志被搅乱的死浮标、一片像被什么东西侧着降过而留下伤疤的农场田地，以及一座在船员称其为故障之前、三度听到同一句静电低语的轨道星际站。

#en: Only out in a ragged asteroid belt could someone hide a sensor web fine-tuned to listen for impossible jumps, far from traffic lanes and official eyes. The rocks scatter normal emissions, turning this patch of space into a blind spot where a careful hand can reroute ships and erase the evidence after. Whatever is anchored here is part of how the routes keep bending around patrol nets, and whoever set it up counted on drifting stone and forgotten survey charts to keep it quiet. So far the trail has been a scrubbed slate on a lonely rock and nervous research logs, all pointing toward altered corridors and a vanished navigator working in the gaps between what corporations admit and what spacers whisper about.
zh: 只有在一片嶙峋的小行星带里，才有人能藏起一张调校得专门聆听不可能之跃迁的传感器网，远离航道与官方的眼睛。岩石散射普通辐射，把这片太空变成盲点，一只谨慎的手可以在那里改道船只、事后抹掉证据。锚定在这里的东西，正是航线为何不断绕着巡逻网弯折的一部分；布置它的人仰赖漂移的岩石与被遗忘的勘探星图，让它保持安静。目前为止，这条线索是一块孤独岩石上被擦净的数据板与紧张的研究日志，全都指向被改动的走廊，以及一名在"公司承认的"与"太空劫匪低语的"之间空隙里运作的失踪领航员。

#en: Out here, away from port authority eyes and clean lanes, paperwork goes to die. This backwater depot is where manifests are rewritten in bad light, where haulers quietly adjust cargo tallies and no one checks the original transmission against what finally gets stamped. If there is a record of ships slipping off the books toward graveyards and forgotten wrecks, it will be buried in the half-corrupted traffic logs people swear are "just how they came in."  \nSo far I have a dead survey site with a stray dataslate, a handful of dockhands near Neon repeating the same story they all swear they heard from someone else, and a pattern of delays in frontier convoys that never quite matches the flight plans on file.
zh: 在这里，远离港务当局的眼睛与干净航道，文书就是来送死的。这座穷乡货运站正是舱单在糟糕灯光下被重写的地方，是货船船员悄悄调整货物清单、而没人拿原始传输去核对最终盖章内容的地方。若说还有船只溜出账册、驶向坟墓与被遗忘残骸的记录，它就会被埋在那半损坏的交通日志里——人们发誓那些日志"送来时就是这个样子"。  \n目前为止，我有一座带着散落数据板的死掉勘探场、几名在霓虹城附近反复讲述同一个故事、并都发誓是听别人说的码头工，以及一个从来对不上存档飞行计划的边境车队延误模式。

#en: The farm ring was never meant to last this long. Hydroponic modules were bolted onto the hull as a stopgap, a way to keep crews fed while corporate worked out a proper supply chain, then forgotten once the ledgers balanced. Years later, the improvised pipework and jury rigged circulation pumps have become part of the ship's skeleton, hiding new grafts in plain sight extra feeds drawing power, nutrient lines re routed to panels that do not grow anything at all. So far the trail runs from a dead buoy with missing minutes in its logs, through a homestead field scarred by a sideways landing, to smug Neon gossip about a pilot who keeps using "temporary" routes everyone else has quietly built their lives around.
zh: 那圈农场本就没打算撑这么久。水培舱当初只是被草草螺栓固定到船壳上应急，好让船员在公司理顺正经供应链之前有饭吃，账本一平衡就被忘掉了。多年之后，那些临时拼凑的管路与勉强凑合的循环泵已成船体骨架的一部分，把新的嫁接藏在众目睽睽之下：额外的供给在耗电，营养管线被改道到根本不长任何东西的种植板上。目前为止，线索从一枚日志里少了几分钟的死浮标，穿过一片被侧向降落留下伤疤的农场田地，延伸到霓虹城地下关于一名飞行员的自负闲谈——他一直在用那些"临时"航线，而其他所有人早已悄悄把生活建在了它们之上。

#en: This quiet farm sits at the edge of nowhere, exactly where someone obsessed with lost ships might hide a map no one is supposed to own. The fields swallow radio noise, the sky stays clear enough for clean grav readings, and the Waggoners already live with a memorial carved from unanswered calls. Whatever was tucked away here was meant to be found only by someone who has walked the same uncertain corridors of omission and edited reports. All we know for sure is fragmentary: a stray dataslate from a forgotten backworld, falsified manifests in a derelict freight yard, and an encrypted tag behind a candlelit plaque, each whispering about altered queues, missing settlers, and a salvager who always arrives first.
zh: 这座安静的农场坐落在天涯之外，恰好是一个痴迷于失踪船只的人会把一份"谁都不该拥有"的地图藏起来的地方。田野吞掉无线电噪声，天空足够清朗、能取得干净的引力读数，而瓦戈纳一家早已与一座由无人接听的呼叫雕成的纪念碑共处。藏在这里的东西，本就只该被某个走过同样那些充满省略与涂改报告的不确定走廊的人找到。我们确定知道的只有碎片：一块来自被遗忘穷乡的散落数据板、一座废弃货运场里被伪造的舱单，以及一块烛光牌匾背后的加密标签，每一处都低语着被改动的队列、失踪的定居者，以及一名总是最先抵达的打捞者。

#en: The beacon drifts in cold, orderly orbit, still slaved to old traffic updates that no one has read in months. This is where the numbers live, the forgotten routing errors and quiet hand-edits that let one tug, one courier, slip through the cracks while everyone trusted the system to catch them. Out here the noise of Neon, Gagarin, and every other crowded port falls away, leaving only the bare pattern of movements and falsified paths that point toward where a shipbreaker with a stolen past would flee. So far the trail runs from a lonely rock and a dead crew's memorial to altered manifests, whispers in the underbelly, and a SysDef log that all agree on one thing: someone hid him in the blind spots on purpose.
zh: 那座信标在冰冷而有序的轨道上漂着，仍被奴役于几个月来无人读过的旧交通更新。这里正是那些数字居住的地方——被遗忘的航线错误与悄悄的手工编辑，让一艘拖船、一艘信使船在所有人都相信系统会拦住它们时从缝隙里溜过。在这里，霓虹城、加加林星以及其他每一座拥挤港市的噪声都褪去，只剩下运动与伪造路径的赤裸模式，指向一个带着偷来的过往的拆船人会逃往何处。目前为止，线索从一块孤独的岩石与一座死掉船员的纪念碑，延伸到被改动的舱单、下层的低语，以及一份星防队日志——它们都同意一件事：有人故意把他藏进了盲点里。

#en: No other place in the Settled Systems concentrates her choices like this forgotten bionics lab, where corporate trial beds and discarded implants still remember the hands that wired them. Every corridor hums with half-finished ideas, emergency power bleeding into surgical frames and neural maps as she prepares to fold herself and her work into the circuitry forever. She has been stripping code from clinics and robotics sites, salvaging firmware and memories, all to rebuild the disaster that made her and decide who it burns this time. From the first shredded case files in that freestar trailer to the gutted machines at the robotics site, every small compromise and favor has curved the trail toward this table.
zh: 在整个定居星系里，没有别的地方像这座被遗忘的仿生学实验室一样，如此集中地呈现她的选择：公司的试验台与被丢弃的植入体，仍记得为它们接线的那双手。每条走廊都嗡鸣着半途而废的构想，应急电力渗进手术架与神经图谱——她正准备把自己和她的作品永久折进电路里。她一直在从诊所与机器人场址上剥离代码，回收固件与记忆，只为重建那场造就了她的灾难，并决定这一次它烧到谁。从那辆自由星系联盟拖车里被撕碎的最初案卷，到机器人场址里被掏空的机器，每一次小小的妥协与恩惠，都把这条线索弯向这张手术台。

#en: Down in Neon's dripping steel gut, where grid-light and storm-rumble bleed together, numbers change hands more quietly than drugs or guns. This is where routes are laundered into rumor, where a single stray calculation can shift a convoy toward profit or disaster without a clerk ever seeing the edit, and where her work has been sliced into saleable fragments. The ledgers and side-channel agreements buried here show which captains, brokers, and data techs have been buying her corrections, each swearing they only heard the pattern from someone else first. So far the trail runs from a redacted hearing in the capital to scattered freighter logs and a half-whispered name passed between LIST crews and Neon fixers.
zh: 在霓虹城滴着水的钢铁内脏里，电网的辉光与风暴的轰鸣交织，数字转手比毒品或枪械还安静。这里正是航线被洗成传闻的地方，一处零散的计算就能把一支车队推向利润或灾难、而文书从来看不见那次编辑的地方，也是她的作品被切成可售碎片的地方。埋在这里的账册与侧信道协议显示，哪些船长、掮客与数据技师一直在购买她的修正，每人都发誓自己只是先从别人那里听来这个模式。目前为止，线索从首都一场涂黑的听证会，延伸到零散的货船日志，以及一个在独立盟船员与霓虹城掮客之间传递的、只说了一半的名字。

#en: Out here, in the drift between rocks, is where someone hid the thing they meant to come back for. The beacon sits in the shadow of shattered stone, quietly listening to two channels at once, routing whispers from frontier habitats toward coordinates that do not appear on any civilian chart. Whoever set this up needed distance from prying traffic and enough clutter to lose a transponder trail, but the unfinished routing tables say they never returned to finish the job. So far the trail runs from shaken settlers at a remote retreat to a buried UC listening post and a derelict hangar full of cannibalized life support rigs, all pointing toward one engineer who treats entire colonies like numbers in an experiment.
zh: 在这里、在岩石之间的漂流带里，有人藏起了他们本打算回来取的东西。那座信标坐在碎石之影中，同时静静聆听两个频道，把来自边境聚居地的低语引向任何民用星图上都不存在的坐标。布置这一切的人需要远离窥探的交通，也需要足够多的杂物来抹掉应答器痕迹，但那些未完成的航线表说明，他们再没回来完成这项差事。目前为止，线索从某处偏远隐居地受惊的定居者，延伸到一座被埋的联殖听音哨与一座塞满被拆解生命维持装置的废弃机库，全都指向一名把整片殖民地当作实验中数字的工程师。

#en: Neon's underside is where systems go to be forgotten, not repaired. Down here, between leaking condensers and flickering conduits, maintenance subroutines and flow controllers keep cycling long after anyone remembers who wrote them or why. If he wanted a place where old logic could keep quietly routing air, water, and data along paths no one audits anymore, this is it. Tapping into those loops will show which corridors he has been riding under the city's nose, and where they empty out once they leave Volii's shadow. So far, the trail runs from a dead rock to a silenced cargo hull, and now to a buried heartbeat in Neon's machinery that has been following his numbers for years without a single human signing off.
zh: 霓虹城的底面，是系统前去被遗忘、而非被修理的地方。在这下面，在渗漏的冷凝器与闪烁的导管之间，维护子程序与流量控制器在所有人都忘了是谁、为何写下它们之后仍不断循环。如果他想要一个让旧逻辑继续悄悄沿着再无人审计的路径输送空气、水与数据的地方，那就是这里。接入那些循环，就能看出他一直在城市眼皮底下走哪些走廊，以及它们离开沃利星的阴影后在哪里倾泻而出。目前为止，线索从一块死岩石到一具被噤声的货船壳，如今又到霓虹城机械里一处被埋藏的心跳——它追随他的数字多年，却没有一个人类签过字。

#en: Tucked into the rock far from any beacon, the pirate relay shack is where bad habits go to rot; smugglers trust it, officials ignore it, and its consoles hum on the same unattended cycles they have used for years. That is why the fragments you are after had to land here: a forgotten junction where altered routes and duplicated bands could slide into storage without triggering alarms, just another day s smuggling traffic until someone finally noticed the pattern. The broker who hid them counted on complacency, on the way routines changed quietly after that dead Navy freighter and those hushed payments to backwater clinics, all lining up with blackout scars on frontier farms no one wanted to write reports about.
zh: 那座嵌在岩石里、远离任何信标的走私者中继小屋，是坏习惯前去腐烂的地方；走私者信任它，官员无视它，而它的控制台仍以多年来同样的无人值守周期嗡鸣。正因如此，你要找的那些碎片才必须落在这里：一处被遗忘的枢纽，被改动的航线与重复的频段可以在不被触发警报的情况下溜进存储，一切不过是又一个走私交通的日常——直到终于有人注意到这个模式。藏起它们的掮客赌的是人们的自满，赌那艘死掉的海军货船、以及付给穷乡诊所的那些压低声音的款项之后，惯例会如何被悄悄改动——而这一切都与边境农场那些没人愿意写报告的黑障伤痕对得上。
